title: wg: protocol-06 §5.6 GroupInfo ratchet_tree presence vs serving
description: Suggestion. §5.6 serves GroupInfo without an embedded ratchet_tree, but a PartialGroupInfo with ratchet_tree_presence=present was signed over one; the spec doesn't say whether the hub must strip it (invalidating the signature) or refuse. mimid refuses such commits (decision mimid-1wgh.6.11).
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): PARTLY. 'omit ratchet_tree' only in struct comments (L1411, L2122); ask to make it MUST, present/added invalid, hub rejects. New issue.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/152
